_header: D1 GOLDEN — sentence ids for the fixture beat + round in tests/engine/feed/__fixtures__/beat.ts.
CHANGING THIS FILE IS A BREAKING CHANGE. Stored run records and archive highlighting are keyed
on these ids; re-splitting one report sentence renumbers every id after it, and every archived
run then silently highlights the wrong text. If a change here is genuinely required, it is a
contract revision, not a test fix.
Hand-derived from spec decisions 1-3: <nn> is per-(run,channel), 1-based, min width 2;
intra-beat allocation order is u -> n -> q(after drops); round end is f -> b; a dropped npc
line consumes no sequence number (q02 belongs to the third raw line, not the second).
